symptom: A page parameter Studio Pro marks not Required (Forms$PageParameter.IsRequired = false, Mendix 11.5+), opened by a menu item with no argument (mx check 0 errors): describe page printed `Params: ( $Sale: MyFirstModule.Sale )`, describe navigation printed `show page MyFirstModule.Sale_View(Sale = $currentObject)`, and executing that output was refused with MDL-PAGEARG01 — the navigation profile could not be changed from MDL (Mendix 11.12.5)
cause: MDL had no spelling for the flag (the builder hard-coded IsRequired true), describe page did not print it, and pageActionParameters synthesised `= $currentObject` for every target parameter when no mapping is stored — right for a required one inside a data widget, wrong for an optional one on a context-less menu item. The reader could not be trusted either: gen's IsRequired() reads an absent key as false, so every pre-11.5 parameter would have looked optional
file: mdl/grammar/domains/MDLPage.g4 (pageParameter OPTIONAL?), MDLLexer.g4 + keyword rule; mdl/visitor/visitor_page.go; mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3.go (IsRequired: !Optional; snippet refusal); cmd_alter_page.go + mdl/backend/modelsdk/page_mutator_write.go (alter add parameters); version_gates_documents.go + sdk/versions/mendix-11.yaml (page_parameter_optional 11.5.0); validate_snippet_parameters.go (MDL087); mdl/backend/modelsdk/page.go (pageParameterIsRequired reads the raw key); cmd_pages_describe.go / cmd_pages_describe_output.go
fix: `Params: ( $P: Type optional )`, written as IsRequired false through CREATE and ALTER … ADD PARAMETERS, gated to 11.5+ (MDL-VERSION01) and refused on a snippet parameter (MDL087); describe page prints `optional`; the implicit `= $currentObject` mapping is only for required parameters; the reader treats an absent IsRequired as required
insight: Before trusting a gen bool accessor for a property newer than the oldest supported version, check what it returns for an absent key: Primitive[bool] gives false, which here would have flipped every pre-11.5 parameter to optional — read element.Raw() and treat absent as the platform's old behaviour; the control (revert to gp.IsRequired()) fails the no-stored-flag test. The real check settles both directions on the 11.6.6 fixture: menu item with no argument → 0 errors with `optional`, CE1571 without. No fixture page (58 parameters in TestApp + PedApp) is optional, so the Studio Pro shape was seeded. Left out: a check for the required case (`show page P` with no argument on a context-less widget is CE1571 only at mx check), and parameter DefaultValue (11.5), which has no spelling and no fixture evidence
